summaries.summary: Rossi, the incumbent Place 4 council member first elected in May 2024 with 57.8% of the vote, is running unopposed for re-election. On her campaign website (connieforjv.org), she outlines priorities including continued support for police, fire, and EMS funding; street drainage repair and flood mitigation with collaboration across neighboring municipalities; preventative maintenance of water and wastewater facilities; government transparency and resident engagement; and economic development through innovative approaches to city revenue. Council meeting minutes from October 2025 show her actively participating in council business, including questioning city staff about resident notifications during water outages and voting unanimously with the full council on infrastructure, parks, and land transactions. No new 2026-cycle Q&A article from Community Impact was published for her race, consistent with her running unopposed.
